title: Continuing Architectural and Landscape Architectural Service
short_description: Framework-style continuing architectural and landscape architectural consulting services for the City of St. Cloud.
project_scope: As-needed continuing professional architectural and landscape architectural services for the City of St. Cloud. Requested disciplines include architecture, landscape architecture, cost estimating, feasibility studies, planning/master planning, electrical engineering, fire protection engineering, and mechanical engineering. No specific building, structure type, size, span, or gross floor area is defined in the notice.
services: Continuing professional services on an as-needed basis: architectural services, landscape architecture, cost estimating, feasibility studies, planning/master planning, and related building engineering disciplines.
relevance_explanation:
- General continuing services contract without a defined project or structural scope.
- Focus is architecture/landscape architecture and building services, not structural or bridge design.
- Includes feasibility studies and planning/master planning, but no clear structural engineering component.
- Resembles a framework/on-call services procurement, which is low priority for sbp.
- No indication of long-span, bridge, special structure, sports, or architecturally demanding building project.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. The notice is for continuing on-call consulting services without a defined project, so no realistic project-specific construction cost estimate can be derived from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. As this is an as-needed continuing services procurement with potentially multiple awards and no defined project scope, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible from the notice alone.
references_qualifications: Qualified and experienced consultants are sought for continuing professional architectural and landscape architectural services. Specific minimum reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds are not stated in the provided notice.
contracting_authority: City of Saint Cloud, St. Cloud, Florida, USA. Contact: Leslie Flores. Phone: 407-957-7212. Fax: 407-957-7369. Email: purchasing@stcloudfl.gov. Website: https://procurement.opengov.com/portal/stcloud/projects/269674
notes: Project number: 2026-043. Procurement stage: RFP/RFQ. Questions deadline: 06/19/2026 05:00 PM EDT. Multiple contracts may be awarded. The notice appears to be an on-call/framework-style procurement rather than a single defined project.
